events.text:
Hello Ms. Mehta, this is calling from Mumbai Bank regarding your credit card account. I hope you're doing well today.

I'm calling about your outstanding balance of ₹48,500, which is now 12 days past due. The minimum amount due is ₹2,425.

I wanted to check if you're able to make the payment today? Non-payment can seriously affect your credit score and may lead to legal action, so I'd like to help you resolve this.

If you're facing any difficulties, please let me know and I'll do my best to assist.
I had some unexpected household expenses this month, so I couldn't make the payment on time. Can you please waive the late fee since this is the first time it's happened?

I understand, Ms. Mehta. Unexpected expenses can happen to anyone. I can look into waiving the late fee of ₹1,500 for you, given this is your first time.

To help me process this, are you able to make a payment towards your balance today? Even paying the minimum due of ₹2,425 would show good faith while we sort out the waiver.

If you're unable to pay anything today, let me know what you can commit to, and we can work out a plan together.
I can pay the minimum amount of ₹2,425 today. Will the late fee be waived if I make this payment?

Yes, Ms. Mehta. If you pay the minimum amount of ₹2,425 today, I can waive the late fee of ₹1,500 as a one-time courtesy.

Once the payment is made, please confirm with me and I'll process the waiver on your account right away.

Can you go ahead and make the payment today?
Yes, I will make the payment now. Please go ahead and waive the late fee.

result.next: Say a short goodbye. The call ends after it.

events.text:
Thank you, Ms. Mehta. I've noted your commitment to pay ₹2,425 today, and I will process the waiver of the ₹1,500 late fee once your payment is confirmed.

Please make the payment as soon as possible and let us know once it's done so we can update your account. Remember, clearing your dues on time helps protect your credit score.

Thank you for banking with Mumbai Bank.

I'll now record this as a promise to pay. Thank you, Ms. Mehta. Have a great day! Goodbye.
